buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods

3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses for 159 BOP installation sites (I) Inspection Clause: (a) in reference to Bid details (Name of the Empanele d inspection Agency/Authority-Post Dispatch Inspection by BOO of SSB afte r installation and commissioning of goods at consignee location. b) Inspection shall be carried out by BOO of SSB at consignee location. c) On the outcome of PDI report, the decision of the buyer regarding accept ance/rejection of consignment shall be final and binding on the seller. d) It shall be the seller's responsibility for safe transportation of the store t o the concerned consignees as per contract followed by Installation and co mmissioning. e) Inspection charges shall be borne by the supplier and it shall not be reim bursed by buyer to them at any point of time as per provision contained in Para-9.12.3 of Manual for Procurement of Goods-2022. f) The Seller shall provide, without any extra charge, all materials, tools, la bour and assistance of every kind which the Inspecting officer may deman d of him for any test, and examination, other than special or independent t est, which he shall require to be made on the seller's premises and the sell er shall bear and pay all costs attendant thereon. g) The seller shall not be entitled to object on any ground whatsoever to th e method of testing adopted by the inspecting agency. The inspection and acceptance provisions shall be read with the generated GeM bid and approved technical specifications. Any required change to a p ublished bid shall be issued only through an approved GeM corrigendum.

II) Warrantee:- Warrantee period of the supplied products shall be 60 mon ths from the date of final acceptance of goods. III) Bank Guarantee Clause:- As per RBI master circular RB1/2009-10/70 Jul y1,2009-Para- 2.2.7.2 and subsequent order, whenever a firm fails to suppl y the stores within the delivery period of the contract wherein bank guaran tee has been furnished, the request for extension for delivery period will au tomatically be taken as an agreement for getting the bank guarantee exte nded. IV) The performance security amount and duration shall be as specified in t he generated GeM bid; the delivery period and warranty coverage shall be aligned with the final contract. If the seller falls to deliver the goods within original Delivery Period, duration of PBG will be suitably extended by the se ller for the delayed period from the date of receipt of last consignment. V) After AOC, seller will be liable for inspection of store by BOO for delivery of goods to all consignee's within original Delivery Period. No further extension of delivery period will be allowed. If the seller fails to deliver the store within original Delivery Period, Liquidated damages will be imposed a s per terms and conditions of GeM GTC. VI) Indian suppliers of this item are not allowed to participate and or compe te in procurement by some foreign governments. Bidders/products from su ch countries are not eligible / not allowed to participate in this bid in terms of clause 10(d) of Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order, 2017. VII) The current bid is governed by GeM GTC, ATC, Buyer added text based ATC, GFR-2017, Manual for procurement of Goods-2022 and subsequent gu idelines/orders circulated by Govt. of India time to time. VIII) Participating firm should not have direct or indirect business relationsh ip with any other participating firm(s) and with their proprietors, participati ng in the current bid. If the same is established at later stage then suitable action will be taken against such firm as per GeM incident Management Pol icy.

IX) Participating firm should not be undergoing Insolvency resolution Proce ss or liquidation or court receivership or bankruptcy or similar proceeding as on date. If this is found to be false at any stage, Sashastra Seema Bal (M HA) shall have the right to reject such bid, if the bid has resulted in a contr act, the contract will be liable for termination without prejudice to any othe r right or remedy available to this organization. X) Participating firm should not be Blacklisted, Suspended, and Debarred b y Government department during the last 01 year. If this is found to be fals e at any stage, Sashastra Seema Bal (MHA) shall have the right to reject su ch bid, if the bid has resulted in a contract, the contract will be liable for ter mination without prejudice to any other right or remedy available to this or ganization. XI) Participation by firm in this bid shall be taken as confirmation on accept ance of all terms and conditions of this bid including amendment/corrigend um thereof. XII) (A) Undertaking with respect to Make in India (MII) (on firm's l etter head) In line with Government Public Procurement Order No. P-45021/2/2017-BE- II dt. 15.06.2017 and No. P-45021/2/2017-PP(BE-II) dt. 04.06.2020 as amen ded from time to time along with clarifications/ amendments and other refe rences as issued from time to time, whereby certify that I/we, M/s_________ ____ (Bidder) having minimum……. % local content of the store. As defined in above orders/circulars/clarifications/amendments for the mat erial against Bid No._______Dated______, details of Location (Complete Addr ess) at which local value addition will be made is as follows:__________. We have also read the clarification issued vide Circular No.: P-45021/102/2 019-BE-II-Part (1) (E-50310), Dated 04.03.2021 and any other subsequent circular/amendment/order as issued by competent authority. (B) Procedure for calculating local content/domestic value addition

as prescribed by DPIIT: Fill the required value :- Total value of the items procured (excluding net domestic indirect t axes) Value of imported content in the item (including all custom duties) Total value of the item procured. Formula:- Local content= Total value of the items procured (excluding net domestic i ndirect taxes) – Value of imported content in the item (including all custom duties) × 100 Total value of the item procured Percentage of Local content- For Class 1- 50% or more & Class 2- 2 0 to 50% We also understand, false declarations will be in breach of the Code of Inte grity under Rule 175(1)(1)(h) of the General Financial Rule for which a bidd er or its successors can be debarred for upto two years as per Rule 151 (iii) of the General Financial Rules along with such other actions as may be per missible under law. s. (XIV) Conditional bids will not be entertained and summarily rejected. (XV) Submission of online scanned copies of unwanted/irrelevant documen ts/out of contest documents will not be considered to be the part of Techni cal Evaluation of bid. The decision of the buyer in this regard will be final a nd binding on the bidder/ bidding firms. (XVI) Pre-bid Conference:- Bidders are requested to attend a Pre-bid conference for clarification on th e Bid's technical specifications and commercial conditions, on the time, dat e, and place as mentioned under. Participation in such a Pre-bid Conferenc e is not mandatory, Bidder may also submit written queries through repres entation window made available by GeM on GeM portal. However, if a bidd er chooses not to (or falls to) participate in the Pre-bid conference or does n ot submit a query through representation window of GeM portal, it shall be assumed that they have no issues regarding the techno/ commercial condit ions. XVII) Experience Criteria:- Any experience criterion selected in the live GeM bid shall be applied as per its generated terms and approved buyer-added conditions. The bidder or its OEM (themselves or through reseller (s)) should have reg ularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar category products to an y Central/State Govt. Organization /PSU/Public Listed Company for last 3 fin ancial years before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contract to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity in at least one of the last 03 financial years before the bid opening date. In case of bunch bids, the primary products having highest value should meet this criterion. For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following docu ments may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:- a) Purchase Order copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bi dder that supplies against the invoices have been executed.

b) Execution certificate by client with order value. c) Any other document in support of order execution like Third Party Inspec tion release Note etc. d) In case bidder submit GeM Contract for experience than copy of GeM inv oice is required to submit along with self-certification by the bidder that su pplies against the Contract executed. (XVIII) Bidders have to submit all relevant documents related to qualificatio n criteria as indicated in bid document:- S/No. Qualification criteria 1. Past Performance as configured in the final GeM bid. 2. Past Experience as configured in the final GeM bid and th is ATC. 3. Turnover as configured in the final GeM bid. 4. OEM Authorization Certificate (if applicable) 5. EMD or valid documents w.r.t claim for exemption of EM D. 6. Note:- Firm may also refer to illustration enclosed herewith at buyer uploaded ATC document as guidance f or filling up the procedure for calculating local content/ d omestic value addition as given in MII undertaking. Note:- Non submission of any of these documents related to the qualificati on criteria will lead to rejection of bid of the firm being a non-responsive bi d. XIX) Supply and installation at the designated Border Outposts:

The seller shall supply, transport, unload, assemble, anchor/fix, install and commission one each of Air Walker Double, Chest Press, Surf Board, Sit-up Board and Leg Press at each of the 159 installation sites listed in Annexure A. Installation, including foundation and anchoring where required by the a pproved specifications, labour, tools, materials and transportation up to the designated installation point, shall be included in the quoted price. No sepa rate payment shall be admissible for movement from a GeM receiving addr ess or unit headquarters to the listed BOP. The GeM consignee/receiving ID identifies the account through which good s are received; it does not replace the BOP installation obligation. The conc erned Commandant shall provide the seller with the exact location, access instructions and nominated site representative before dispatch. Goods shal l be inspected and accepted in accordance with the GeM contract only afte r installation and functional verification at the allotted BOP. A receipt at a u nit headquarters or transit camp alone shall not constitute completion of in stallation. For 69 Bn, Lingtham and Talkharka are separate installation sites although receipt is mapped through the Mulkharka GeM consignee ID. For 72 Bn, the common transit-camp receiving arrangement shall be followed by installati on at its 15 separately named sites. The delivery period and warranty shall be those stated in the final GeM bid and contract. The site-wise installation certificate shall identify the unit, BO P, five installed items, date of commissioning and inspecting/receiving offic er. XX) Availability of Service Centre: The bidder/OEM shall have one functional service centre within the Area of Responsibility (AOR) of Frontier HQ SSB Siliguri to support all 159 installati on sites listed in Annexure A. If such a center is not functional at the time o f bidding, the successful seller/OEM shall establish or formally authorize on e within 30 days of award of contract. The center shall provide on-site warr anty service at the designated BOPs throughout the warranty period specifi ed in this bid, without any additional charge to the buyer. The successful se ller shall submit the center’s full address, contact details and documentary evidence of its functional status and its authority to service the supplied eq uipment. Payment shall be released only after submission of this evidence and completion of the other acceptance requirements under the GeM contr act.
